findings.evidence: Passengers should review the updated schedule at any station kiosk.
findings.fix: Use a darker text color such as #595959 or verify the contrast ratio meets 4.5:1 minimum against the actual background.

findings.fix: Change the label's for attribute from "topic-alt" to "topic" to properly associate the label with the select element.
findings.violation: The label's for attribute references "topic-alt" but the select element has id="topic", creating a mismatch that breaks the label association.

findings.evidence: <input id="promo" type="text" aria-invalid="true"> <span class="error-text" id="s3-form-promo-error">Enter a 6 character code...
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the input element to associate it with the error text.
findings.violation: The input with aria-invalid="true" is not programmatically linked to its error message via aria-describedby.

findings.evidence: read the accessibility improvements list

findings.fix: Implement proper click and keyboard (Enter/Space) handlers using JavaScript, add visual focus and active states with CSS, or replace with a native <button> element.
